narrative.headline: Smart money is rotating into rate-sensitive Real Estate and Financials while airlines and oilfield services show conflicting flow beneath the surface.
bullish_themes: Real Estate complex leading the tape — REIT specialty (FRMI, CCI) and real estate services (CBRE) show clean ask-side accumulation with 93%+ bullish premium
Financials broad-based bid across asset managers (KKR, STT, BX) and mortgage/regional banks (RKT, FITB) — consistent with a rate-cut positioning trade
Healthcare devices and facilities quietly accumulating (THC, ABT, GMED, EW) — defensive rotation with THC printing $2.4M at 95.5% bullish
Industrials bifurcated: security services (GEO), metals (ATI), and rails (UNP) bullish while airlines split hard between UAL long and DAL/AAL/JBLU short
notable_individual_flows: FRMI — $1.95M premium, 96.3% bullish, 38 ask-side prints; highest-conviction name on the board
THC — $2.42M at 95.5% bullish with 19 ask-side prints, cleanest large-cap healthcare signal
CLF — $3.66M premium but only 62% bullish; size is real but conviction is muddy
UAL vs AAL/DAL/JBLU — $2.46M bullish on UAL against $4.5M combined bearish across the rest of the group; pair trade signature
Oilfield services (SLB, HAL, LBRT) uniformly bearish — LBRT at 100% bearish is a standout negative tell
narrative.absences: Zero bullish flow in XLK, XLC, or XLY despite broad market strength — no mega-cap tech, no consumer discretionary, no semis. Energy is actively bearish rather than absent, which is a stronger negative signal than silence.
